A London merchant, and the first Hutchins whose dealings with America are recorded.
He was one of the thirty-three men who organized the Massachusetts Bay Company and received its royal charter from
Charles I in 1628 to 29. Endecott founded Salem in 1628; Winthrop followed in 1630 with some 700 settlers.
Thomas was still in London in 1635, and the book could not find that he ever crossed.
It holds that the Hutchinses who sailed with Endecott and Winthrop were probably his kin.
